facts.business: Norris Medicines Limited operates in the pharmaceutical sector, engaged in the manufacturing and sale of medicines.

auditor.name: BAHEDIA & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provision of gratuity liability based on actuarial valuation as required by Ind AS 19 and non-settlement of matured gratuity dues, constituting non-compliance with the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972. Key audit matters include going concern uncertainty due to net losses of Rs. 28.06 lakhs, negative working capital of Rs. 3.71 crore, inability to meet payroll obligations, and failure to deposit statutory dues on time.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses and negative working capital
Continuous failure to deposit statutory dues within prescribed timelines
Non-provision of gratuity liability as per Ind AS 19
Non-compliance with Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
Liquidity stress and severe working capital deficits
